EmailVerificationRejectedDescription: Your email verification was rejected. Please try again with the correct email.
EmailVerificationPendingDescription: Open the verification link sent to your email, then come back and check your status.
EmailVerificationDescription: Enter the email you want to verify. If it is different from your login email, Firebase will verify it first and then update your account email.
PhotoVerificationRejectedDescription: Your selfie was rejected. Please try again using a clear front-facing picture.

VerifyAccountEmailAlreadyVerifiedMessage: Your email address is already verified.
VerifyAccountEmailSentMessage: Please open the verification link sent to your email. If the email address changes successfully, you may need to sign in again using the new email address.
VerifyAccountRequiresRecentLogin: For security, please log out and log back in, then try changing your email again.
VerifyAccountEmailAlreadyInUse: This email cannot be used. Please enter a different email address.
VerifyAccountInvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
VerifyAccountEmailSendError: We could not send the verification email. Please check the email address and try again.
VerifyAccountEmailApprovedMessage: Your email has been verified successfully.
VerifyAccountEmailPendingMessage: Your email is not verified yet. Please open the latest verification link first.
VerifyAccountEmailCheckError: We could not check your email verification. Please try again.
VerifyAccountPhotoSubmittedMessage: Your selfie was submitted. Our team will review it as soon as possible.
VerifyAccountPhotoSubmitError: We could not submit your selfie. Please try again.
VerifyAccountDescription: Verify your account to stay secure
VerifyAccountStepEmail: 1. Verify your email address by opening the link sent to your inbox.
VerifyAccountStepPhoto: 2. Take a clear selfie so our team can compare it with your profile photo.
